SO MUCH MORE THAN “CHEESE!”
Jan 2024 • Couples
dips, coffee options & all the way to their desserts; there is a lot to be enjoyed!

Even their breads are baked in house, are light and fluffy, not full of heavy dough, and very flavorful. 

Another addition that makes us such a great experience, is the conscious level of the owner and creator. She created the menu and her dishes in mind of being not just plant-based, but healthy! She uses organic products and produce, no additives, preservatives, or refined sugars, so she is not making something that is delicious and enjoyable, but absolutely healthy for the human body and good for the environment as well.

This is a must for all not just Plantbased individuals, but people that enjoy & appreciate enjoy good quality and delicious food, with an appreciation of great culinary creations!!

It's a MUST if you are a vegan in HCM City!
Apr 2022
I've been vegan for well over a decade, and the sandwiches at Kashew are some of the best in the world. If you didn't know you were eating it in Vietnam, you'd swear you were at one of the finest vegan shops in Paris. Though we never stay in District 2, it's worth a Grab or taxi ride over just to dine at Kashew! I generally prefer to eat Vietnamese food while I'm in Vietnam, but I make an exception for Kashew....it's absolutely outstanding. And their mango lassi is to die for! My highest recommendation!
